findings.finding: Status poll aborts on HTTP errors: non-ok HTTP/transport responses set still_pending=false and exit the poll loop instead of retrying within the bounded TTL, risking permanent drop of a later ISSUED authorization.

next_required_before_retry: Fix status-poll transient HTTP handling so still_pending remains true for transport/parse errors within poll_count<300 / pending TTL, re-run target+regressions+BugBot once, then re-apply WF40 seam lane and continue live proof with new run.
